rule: A zone is introduced by a short card of two or three sentences with a title and a discover hint. Each zone also has one region lore page of two sentences. Each zone's quest-giver leaves a chain of six notes, unlocked in order; each note has a title and a body. Props and rooms carry a name and a one-line description. A numbered sequence of six ghost-hero lines per zone paces the story. Numbers are counts of message keys and sentences, not game balance values.
keep: Zone card of 2-3 sentences plus a title: reads in one glance on a 375-wide phone.
One chained set of six notes per quest-giver, unlocked in order.
One short description line per prop or room, so the zone has texture without a long text block.
Numbered ghost-hero lines as a pacing device for a zone.
Inspiration for the shape only: a zone card, a note chain, a numbered sequence.
change: Our own voice and our own names; no protected message text carried over.
Note topics written fresh per character, not reused from the donor's chain categories.
Unlocks decided by server events in the ledger; client only shows the card.
Our zone template set (for example five zone tiers) instead of this donor's five zone names.
look_test: On one phone at 375 wide, show one zone twice: (a) a zone card with title and a two-line body; (b) the same card with a three-line body and one prop line below. Then show one quest-giver note card with its title and body. Dom judges whether three lines read in one glance and which card feels like a place.
